semantic_judgments.reason: The English cover title row carries the centered title placeholder 'Title of Graduation Paper' followed by a parenthetical format instruction '（四号Times New Roman，加粗，居中）' that only describes the typeface (size 4 Times New Roman, bold, centered) and is not part of any fillable value. The 21 leading spaces are indentation that preserves the centered layout when the title is replaced; the single space between the placeholder text and the parenthetical separates the value position from the format instruction. The placeholder text binds to the vocabulary field thesis.title.en ('英文论文题目', content_type text, fill_slot role) because the row's only fillable content is the complete English title; the label/wording, surrounding spaces, and the parenthetical format cue are kept as style/layout responsibilities.

The row is the English-cover author line: the literal English label 'Student:' is a fixed label (kept verbatim with its colon as the separator), and the immediately adjacent '×××' runs are the placeholder for the student name to be supplied; they bind to the vocabulary field author.name.en ('作者英文姓名', content_type text, fill_slot role). The two spaces that follow separate the value position from the parenthetical format cue '（五号Times New Roman，居中）', which only describes the styling (size 5 Times New Roman, centered) and stays as style_only. No part is left uncovered: 'Student:' (8) + '×××' (3) + 2 spaces + '（五号Times New Roman，居中）' (22) reproduces the full 35-character source entry.

English tutor/advisor line: 'Tutor:' is the fixed English label naming the advisor role. '××××' is the placeholder for the advisor's English name on the English cover, bound to advisor.name.en (fill_slot). No formatting annotation appears on this line, so no style_only fragment is needed beyond the label and value.

Affiliation line on English cover: '(College of' (opening paren + English label 'College of') is the fixed prefix. '×××××××' is the placeholder for the English department/college name on the English cover, bound to author.department.en (fill_slot; vocabulary explicitly covers English cover usage). ', Hunan Agricultural University, Changsha 410128, China)' is the fixed institutional and location suffix including the closing paren and is a fixed_label. Together the line yields '(College of <English dept>, Hunan Agricultural University, Changsha 410128, China)'.

Standalone Chinese formatting instruction in full-width parens: '（五号字空一行）' prescribes 5号-size font with one blank line of spacing. It carries no content value, so the entire fragment is style_only (layout/spacing requirement for the English cover unit).
